print(video_web_search)
```
I’m checking the video page directly for its title, description, and accessible transcript metadata.
```python
video_page = await web_fetch("https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM", max_chars=12000)
print(video_page)
```
I’ll use a transcript-capable public lookup as a fallback and extract the specific numeric claim.
```python
video_lookup = await web_search("site:youtube.com/watch L1vXCYZAYYM", max_results=10)
print(video_lookup)
```
The public search response is unavailable in a usable form, so I’m querying YouTube’s page through a command-line metadata endpoint and will inspect the returned text for the answer.
```python
metadata_command = await run_command("python -c \"import urllib.request; print(urllib.request.urlopen('https://www.youtube.com/oembed?url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM&format=json').read().decode())\"")
print(metadata_command)
```
I’m narrowing the search to the wording of the question, which may surface a page or transcript segment quoting the count directly.
